content: If you are interested in contributing to this topic, you are encouraged to take over this page and apply for the position of Editor-in-Chief. There can be one or multiple individuals serving as Editor-in-Chief for this topic. Additionally, you may apply to become an Associate Editor-in-Chief for one of the subtopics listed below. To express your interest in serving as either the Editor-in-Chief for the entire topic or as an Associate Editor-in-Chief for a specific subtopic, please send us an email. Be sure to include your curriculum vitae (CV) and/or a biographical sketch as part of your application. For those selecting a medical school, it is recommended to choose an institution based on your GPA, MCAT score, and other relevant factors.
